nodes.description: Private mapping(address=>uint256) counting how many times an address has sold, used to enforce per-address sale limits.
Private mapping(address=>bool) marking addresses whitelisted to bypass the sell restriction in ensure().
Private minimum sale amount (scaled by decimals), enforced in condition().
Private maximum sale amount (scaled by decimals), enforced in condition().
Private global number of allowed sales per address, enforced in condition().
Privileged address that is exempted from sell restrictions in ensure().
Public mapping(address=>uint) of token balances; mutated without SafeMath in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) of spending allowances.
Constant public decimals = 18 used for scaling in _mints and init.
Public total token supply set in the constructor.
Public token name set in the constructor.
Public token symbol set in the constructor.
Private owner address; gate for delegate, _mints, init, batchSend and setTradeAddress.
Constant Uniswap Router address 0x7a25...488D that is exempted from sell restrictions.
Public payable transfer that simply forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
Internal view gate deciding whether a transfer is allowed; whitelists owner, UNI, tradeAddress and canSale addresses, otherwise delegates to condition().
Public payable token transfer with allowance deduction and unchecked balance arithmetic; core value-moving entry point.
Public payable approval of a spender to spend msg.sender's tokens.
Internal view that enforces _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum sale restrictions.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary low-level delegatecall to caller-supplied address with caller-supplied calldata.
Privileged mint function that sets balanceOf[spender] and marks the address as canSale.
Owner-only initialization of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only batch transfer that debits value*length with unchecked arithmetic and credits recipients in a loop.
Owner-only setter for the privileged tradeAddress whitelist slot.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address derivation using CREATE2 hashing.
Payable constructor that sets metadata, supply, owner=msg.sender and a max allowance for the Uniswap router.
Attacker-controllable caller address used for authorization checks and as the origin of transfers.
Low-level delegatecall a.delegatecall(b) executing arbitrary external code in the contract's storage context.
Unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value arithmetic without SafeMath in transferFrom.
Unchecked multiplication _value * _tos.length and balance debits/credits without SafeMath in batchSend.

edges.reason: _to parameter flows into transfer().
_value parameter flows into transfer().
_from parameter flows into transferFrom() and indexes balanceOf.
_to parameter flows into transferFrom() and indexes balanceOf.
_value parameter flows into unchecked balance arithmetic in transferFrom().
_spender parameter flows into approve() and the allowance mapping.
_value parameter flows into approve().
target address a flows into delegate().
calldata b flows into delegate().
spender parameter is credited in _mints().
addedValue parameter sets balanceOf[spender] in _mints().
saleNum parameter sets _saleNum in init().
token parameter sets _minSale in init().
maxToken parameter sets _maxSale in init().
_tos array is iterated in batchSend().
_value is multiplied by array length in batchSend().
unchecked total computation is subtracted from the sender balance in batchSend().
loop index i drives the batchSend() transfer loop.
loop recipient _to is credited inside batchSend().
addr parameter is written into tradeAddress in setTradeAddress().
factory parameter is hashed in pairFor().
tokenA parameter is hashed in pairFor().
tokenB parameter is hashed in pairFor().
pair local variable is computed and returned by pairFor().
_name constructor argument sets name.
_symbol constructor argument sets symbol.
_supply constructor argument sets totalSupply and the owner balance.
msg.sender is used as the from-address of transfer().
msg.sender is compared against _from to decide whether to spend allowance in transferFrom().
msg.sender becomes the allowance owner in approve().
msg.sender must equal owner to execute the delegatecall in delegate().
msg.sender must be owner or a hard-coded address to mint in _mints().
msg.sender must equal owner to change sale limits in init().
msg.sender must equal owner to batch transfer and is the debited account.
msg.sender must equal owner to set tradeAddress.
msg.sender becomes owner and receives the entire supply in the constructor.
transfer() delegates execution to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
transferFrom() calls ensure() before mutating balances.
ensure() calls condition() for non-whitelisted senders.
transferFrom() performs unchecked balance decrement/increment.
batchSend() performs unchecked total/balance arithmetic.
delegate() invokes a caller-controlled delegatecall, executing arbitrary external code in this contract's context.
balanceOf mapping is read and written by transferFrom().
allowance mapping is read and decremented by transferFrom().
balanceOf mapping is read and written by batchSend().
canSale whitelist bypasses the limit check in ensure().
tradeAddress whitelist bypasses the limit check in ensure().
owner address is whitelisted in ensure().
owner gate protects the delegatecall in delegate().
owner gate protects minting in _mints().
owner gate protects init().
owner gate protects batchSend().
owner gate protects setTradeAddress().
owner is assigned from msg.sender in the constructor.
_mints() sets canSale[spender]=true, enabling the whitelist bypass.
_mints() writes balanceOf[spender].
_onSaleNum counts are compared against _saleNum in condition().
_minSale bound is checked in condition().
_maxSale bound is checked in condition().
_saleNum limit is checked in condition().

normalization_plan.reason: transfer() takes no action on _to itself; it is passed straight to transferFrom and collapses into the transfer() entry point.
_value of transfer() is only forwarded to transferFrom; represents the function's value argument.
_from is the sole indexed account driving allowance and balance accounting in transferFrom().
_to is only used as the credit index inside transferFrom().
_value is the amount argument of the unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom().
_spender indexes the allowance mapping in approve().
_value is the approved amount argument of approve().
target address a is the callee of the delegatecall issued by delegate().
arbitrary calldata b is the payload of the low-level delegatecall operation.
spender is the credited account and whitelist entry inside _mints().
addedValue is the minted amount argument of _mints().
saleNum is stored into the sale-limit state by init().
token is stored into the minimum sale state by init().
maxToken is stored into the maximum sale state by init().
_tos is the recipient array iterated by batchSend().
_value is the per-recipient amount argument of batchSend().
total is the unchecked multiplication accumulated before balance debiting in batchSend().
i is the loop counter that drives the batchSend() transfer loop.
_to is the per-iteration recipient stored inside the batchSend() loop.
addr is written into the privileged tradeAddress state by setTradeAddress().
factory is a hashing input of the CREATE2 derivation in pairFor().
tokenA is ordered and hashed in the pair derivation of pairFor().
tokenB is ordered and hashed in the pair derivation of pairFor().
pair is the computed address returned by pairFor().
_name is stored into the name metadata by the constructor.
_symbol is stored into the symbol metadata by the constructor.
_supply determines totalSupply and the initial owner balance in the constructor.
